Chapter 1094: Chapter 23 Transformation of Strength (Subscription Requested)

Endless Chaos Qi surged, rolling deeper in.

Under the desperate exertion of the black-bearded man at the peak of the Dominator Realm.

The silver ship struggled to sail against the current, like a lonely boat on a vast ocean, poised to capsize at any moment amidst the chaotic Qi surrounding it.

Cold sweat dripped from the black-bearded man’s brow; as time passed, he faintly perceived a terrifying gravitational pull, as if a giant beast was devouring the skies.

The junior brothers and sisters beside him finally realized the gravity of the situation and stood trembling in the corners.

“Hold on, hold on.”

The black-bearded man took a deep breath, resolutely beginning to burn his Inner Universe Origin Source.

For a Twelfth Layer powerhouse, the Inner Universe was the foundation of their being, burning the Inner Universe Origin Source was akin to burning the foundation.

Though this would indeed bring a significant boost in strength, the resulting consequences would be unbearable, leading to irreversible damage.

But at this moment, the black-bearded man could not afford to worry about that.

He had a feeling that if they couldn’t withstand the omnipresent pull, their fate would be far worse than burning their Inner Universe Origin Source.

Buzzing noises filled the air.

Inside the silver ship, formations were running in overdrive.

No one knew how much time had passed when the black-bearded man finally noticed that the gravitational pull around them was gradually weakening.

“Have we broken free?”

The black-bearded man’s breath was unsteady, but his face showed wild joy, furiously increasing the propulsion of the silver ship.

At last, the silver ship steadied slightly, breaking free from the astonishing gravitational pull.

“Whew!”

The black-bearded man stepped back a few steps.

He no longer knew how long it had been since he fought so desperately; the scene he just experienced made him feel as if he had returned to his Sixth Layer existence, witnessing a peak Dominator Realm ancestor in the sect.

No, this feeling now was far more shocking and desperate.

“Senior brother, are we… are we safe now?”

At this time, the junior brothers and sisters in the nearby Path Splitting Realm cautiously walked over and asked probing questions.

“Barring any unexpected events, we should be safe now.”

The black-bearded man thought for a moment, his tone not too certain.

The heavens knew whether that astonishing gravitational pull would return or even strengthen, but given the current situation, it seemed they were out of danger.

Upon hearing this, the junior brothers and sisters felt a sense of relief.

“Senior brother, what was that gravitational pull just now?”

“Yeah, it felt like my soul and mind were being drawn away.”

The junior brothers and sisters immediately inquired, their hearts still faintly trembling.

“I’m not sure either.”

The black-bearded man shook his head, “Probably some spectacle life in the Chaos Realm is inhaling?”

The black-bearded man had seen the Chaos Venerable; the strongest in his faction was a Venerable.

But even a Venerable couldn’t possible inhale all the Chaos Qi from the Chaos Void spanning millions to billions of light years, right?

Only those spectacle beings born from the Chaos Void, with Innate strong talent and aptitude, could possibly cause such a scene.

“Spectacle life?”

“Chaos Realm level?”

The junior brothers and sisters swallowed, spectacle beings were inherently powerful, often sweeping across peers; those with special bloodlines could even challenge a peak Dominator Realm at the Chaos Venerable level.

A spectacle being of the Chaos Realm?

Such an existence, ordinary Chaos Venerables would likely not dare provoke.

“We’re quite lucky that Chaos Realm spectacle being didn’t pay attention to us.”

The black-bearded man’s voice carried a tone of fortunate relief, from detecting the pull to finally barely breaking free, he faced no obstruction.

This was also the key to his escape.

“We are too weak; in the eyes of the Chaos Realm spectacle being, we’re probably no different from the drifting Chaos Qi, hence they wouldn’t focus on us…”

The black-bearded man felt slightly emotional; sometimes being weak is actually a good thing?

…

Amidst the surging endless Chaos Qi, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in silence.

At this moment, Lin Yuan fully released constraints, appearing in this chaotic abyss in his true form, exceeding tens of millions of light years in size; every inhale and exhale engulfed a massive amount of Chaos Qi.

“Finally crossed into the Dominator Realm.”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, a smile on his face.

Entering the Dominator Realm signifies a fundamental transformation in life’s essence, naturally requiring vast energy support.

In this Chaos Void, there was no shortage of Chaos Qi, which was also a form of energy; however, the Chaos Qi ubiquitous in the Chaos Void isn’t pure, making it hard for Path Splitting Realm or Dominator Realm beings to directly absorb.

But Lin Yuan was different; he had long comprehended the method to directly absorb Chaos Qi, and with his profound foundation, even the most heterogeneous Chaos Qi could be forcibly absorbed.

Regardless of whether it’s heterogeneous or pure, it is fundamentally energy.

“Now I…”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed his own transformation.

After entering the Dominator Realm, the most significant change was naturally the Inner Universe.

“The Inner Universe now spans over a hundred billion light years.” Lin Yuan felt joyous in spirit.

At the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, Lin Yuan’s ultimate Inner Universe spanned about thirty-three million light years.

Now it directly reached a hundred billion light years? The diameter alone increased by three hundred times.

In terms of volume, the growth far exceeded three hundred times.

“A hundred billion light years, Inner Universe, is only its size upon my initial entry into the Dominator Realm, and it will rapidly grow later on…”
